title: TD SYNNEX Recognized with Multiple 2026 HPE Partner of the Year Awards Across North America and Europe
summary: TD SYNNEX celebrated as Distributor of the Year in North America and North Western Europe for second consecutive year TD SYNNEX (NYSE:SNX), a leading global distributor and solutions aggregator for the IT ecosystem, today announced it has earned multiple awards from HPE across Europe and North America. These awards honor HPE partners who have demonstrated outstanding dedication and success in providing value to their customers and helping them realize their full growth potential. The recognition is awarded to HPE partners who have achieved exceptional performance in financial results, innovative solutions and significant business outcomes.
